Rasulullaah ﷺ Teaches Adhkaar and Du'aas to Some Sahabah (RA)

Hadhrat Sa'd bin Junaadah (RA) says, "I was one of the first persons from the people of Taa'if to meet Rasulullaah ﷺ (to accept Islaam). I left early in the morning from Saraat in the upper reaches of Taa'if and reached Mina at the time of Asr. I then climbed a mountain and descended (to Makkah where I accepted Islaam). Rasulullaah ﷺ then taught me the words:

blocks.arabic_text: سُبْحَانَ اللّٰهِ وَالْحَمْدُ لِلّٰهِ وَلَا إِلٰهَ إِلَّا اللّٰهُ وَاللّٰهُ أَكْبَرُ

blocks.text: Rasulullaah ﷺ then said, "These words are the Baaqiyaatus Saalihaat (everlasting good deeds) [^2]." [^3]
Hadhrat Ubay bin Ka'b (RA) narrates that Rasulullaah ﷺ taught them to recite the following du'aa every morning:

blocks.arabic_text: أَصْبَحْنَا عَلَى فِطْرَةِ الْإِسْلَامِ وَكَلِمَةِ الْإِخْلَاصِ وَسُنَّةِ نَبِيِّنَا مُحَمَّدٍ صَلَّى اللّٰهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ وَمِلَّةِ إِبْرَاهِيمَ حَنِيفًا وَمَا كَانَ مِنَ الْمُشْرِكِينَ
blocks.text:
"We begin the morning on the natural way of Islaam, the Kalimah of sincerity, the Sunnah of our Nabi Muhammad ﷺ and on the creed of Hadhrat Ibraheem (AS) who was never a Mushrik."
Rasulullaah ﷺ also taught them to recite the same du'aa in the evenings." [^4]
Hadhrat Sa'd (RA) reports that Rasulullaah ﷺ taught them the following du'aa just as a teacher would teach children to write:

blocks.arabic_text: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنَ الْبُخْلِ وَأَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنَ الْجُبْنِ وَأَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ أَنْ أُرَدَّ إِلَى أَرْذَلِ الْعُمُرِ وَأَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ فِتْنَةِ الدُّنْيَا وَعَذَابِ الْقَبْرِ
blocks.text: "O Allaah! I beseech You to protect me from miserliness, from cowardice, from being returned to an age of infirmity (senility), from the tribulations of this world and from punishment in the grave." [^5]
Hadhrat Naufal narrates, "Rasulullaah ﷺ taught us the following du'aa to be recited when a person passes away:

blocks.arabic_text: اللَّهُمَّ اغْفِرْ لِإِخْوَانِنَا وَأَصْلِحْ ذَاتَ بَيْنِنَا وَأَلِّفْ بَيْنَ قُلُوبِنَا اللَّهُمَّ هٰذَا عَبْدُكَ فُلَانُ ابْنُ فُلَانٍ وَلَا نَعْلَمُ إِلَّا خَيْرًا وَأَنْتَ أَعْلَمُ بِهِ مِنَّا فَاغْفِرْ لَنَا وَلَهُ
blocks.text:
'O Allaah! Forgive our brothers, unite us and create love between us. O Allaah! We know only good of this servant of Yours (take his name) but You know him better than us. Do forgive us and him.'
